node.statement: Uniform bounds for the four terms. The first is at most D*e||x||||y|| by node 1.3 and exact source submultiplicativity; the second is at most alpha||x||||y|| by the extended inclusion. For the third, insert T_n(x)v_n(y), use the epsilon-C*-product bound, node 1.3, ||v_n(z)||<=(1+alpha)||z||, and node 1.4 to get at most 2*D*(K_N+3)*e||x||||y|| when e<=1. Since T_n(x),T_n(y) lie in the amplified square corner, lem-compcb-rectangular-product gives for the fourth at most C_r*e||T_n(x)||||T_n(y)||<=C_r*(1+K_N)^2*e||x||||y||. Therefore K_M:=D+1+2*D*(K_N+3)+C_r*(1+K_N)^2 is finite, universal, and bounds the sum.
